title_vi: Chín thuật toán dùng khắp đời sống số

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Bài kia nói cách đọc thang sao của thuật toán nên biết cho phỏng vấn thiết kế hệ thống.

claims.reason: library documentation read in raw copies at the pinned commits; the seven small experiments were run by the author on 2026-10-19 (Python 3.13.16, NetworkX and SymPy from PyPI); the PyTorch pages were read, not run

mobile.reason: figure text measured in Chromium by scripts.figures check --browser (14 px at a 375 px screen); no whole-lesson render at 320, 375 and 430 px recorded

claims.claim_vi: Python's sort is guaranteed stable and its Timsort takes advantage of any ordering already present in the data.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; the small stable-sort example was run.

claims.claim_vi: The Java array sorting methods note that the sorting algorithm is a Dual-Pivot Quicksort.
RSAKeyGenParameterSpec carries the modulus size in bits and the public exponent for generating an RSA key pair.
NetworkX describes PageRank as ranking nodes by the structure of incoming links, originally designed for web pages.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit. The PageRank scores in the lesson come from the author's own power iteration (damping 0.85), not from NetworkX.

claims.claim_vi: NetworkX computes weighted shortest paths with Dijkstra's method; on the four-node example dijkstra_path returns A, C, B, D (length 4).
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; dijkstra_path run with NetworkX from PyPI.

claims.claim_vi: SymPy's factorint returns the prime factors of a positive integer with their multiplicities; factorint(360) is {2: 3, 3: 2, 5: 1} and factorint(3233) is {53: 1, 61: 1}.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit and run.

claims.claim_vi: Python's hashlib offers SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and the SHA-3 series; the SHA-256 of b'abc' starts with ba7816bf and is 64 hexadecimal characters.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; digest run.

claims.claim_vi: zlib's deflate compresses literals and match lengths with one Huffman tree and match distances with another. A Huffman code built by the author for abracadabra takes 23 bits against 88 bits at 8 bits per letter.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; the Huffman construction was run by the author.

claims.claim_vi: Toy RSA: n = 61 x 53 = 3233, public exponent 17, private exponent 2753; 65 encrypts to 2790 and decrypts back to 65.
claims.verified_by: Computed by the author with Python's three-argument pow; the numbers are far too small to be secure.

claims.claim_vi: PyTorch's Transformer layer implements the original architecture of Attention Is All You Need as a reference implementation (defaults 8 heads, 6 encoder and 6 decoder layers).
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; not run.

claims.claim_vi: PyTorch's Conv2d applies a 2D convolution over an input signal composed of several input planes.
claims.verified_by: Read from the pinned commit; not run.

design_notes_vi: Ba nhóm thẻ, mỗi thẻ một kết quả của phép thử nhỏ, và một khung ghi nhớ. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source gives the nine algorithm names and one opening sentence, with the descriptions inside an image; the lesson keeps only the nine names and replaces the opening sentence and the image with its own experiments and library documentation.
The source's statement about where the algorithms are used is not repeated; the lesson does not assign any algorithm to a product.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Phép thử chỉ minh họa; các câu giải nghĩa RSA, SHA, CNN là kiến thức chung của người biên soạn. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
